config.notes: PROOF RUN (migrated from the published BENCHMARKS.md head-to-head, main@c66668c, 2026-07-11). EAGLE-3 sibling of the DSpark proof draft: same Nemotron-Nano target, same ~19K cache, same 74-step / 2-epoch budget, same eval config. Metric is mean accepted length (1 + mean accepted draft tokens; 7 tokens proposed per step). Aggregate first-token acceptance ~11% (vs DSpark ~21%). Eval: DeepSpec acceptance eval, 10-15 prompts per task, 128 max new tokens. Small samples -- trust the direction, not the third decimal. DSpark beat EAGLE-3 on every one of the nine tasks at this equal, small budget; whether that lead holds at full training is a separate (scaling) question. Per-task acceptance was not reported separately, so only accepted_length is recorded here.
